description: Writes to a remote service. Pins an image, returning {avatarCID, avatarFileName, avatarUrl}. PREFER `filePath`; never pass base64 through the conversation. Magic-byte validated (JPEG/PNG/WebP/GIF only — SVG/HTML render broken on app.dexe.io); renamed `.jpeg`; CID v1 base32.

base64.description: Base64 image bytes — only when the image isn't a local file.

contentType.description: Caller-claimed MIME type. Informational only — the pinned MIME comes from byte sniffing.

fileName.description: Base filename; extension will be normalized to .jpeg

filePath.description: Absolute path to a local image (JPEG/PNG/WebP/GIF, max 10 MB). Preferred over base64.

name: dexe_ipfs_upload_avatar

avatarCID.description: CID v1 base32 — pass to upload_dao_metadata as avatarCID.

avatarUrl.description: Full subdomain-gateway URL — what the frontend stores verbatim.

detectedFormat.description: Raster format detected from magic bytes (jpeg|png|webp|gif).

title: Upload a DAO avatar (one-shot: pins + returns avatarCID/avatarFileName/avatarUrl)
